result_text:
The parent landscape report no longer aborts when a sub-landscape has no readable `config.json`. The fix is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportSubLandscapesSection.java`, in `addSubLandscapeRow`.

The NPE came from `subLandscapeConfig.getMetadata()` dereferencing the null that `getSubLandscapeConfig` returns when the file can't be read. Now a null config, or one with no metadata, yields a null logo link. The row then takes the existing default-logo branch, and the link to the index page is unchanged. Sub-landscapes with a readable config still get their own logo.

The reports module compiles offline. I did not run an end-to-end generation with a missing `config.json`, and the module has no tests for this section. Nothing is committed.
